Questions

Before you start

Is this therapy?

No. APC offers parent education and structured parent support, not therapy, diagnosis or treatment.

Is it online?

Yes. Sessions are online, for families in Malaysia, Singapore and internationally.

What happens when I sign up for the Quick Check?

The signup sends the guide and two short follow-up emails. Ongoing parent updates are optional.

What if I am not sure Home Support fits?

Book the free 15-minute First Step Call. CJ checks fit with you before any payment.
